subject: RENAMES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1283 (wave 1011 B2). cite.py --check 13.18.45.3 'All RENAMES entries referring to data items within a given record shall immediately follow the last data description entry' OK SR2. BindEntries tracks whether the current record's 66 entries have begun (a later level 02-49 entry is COBOL2740) and binds a 66 to the record THIS walk has open - never _lastRoot, which outlives the walk and would hand a section's first 66 the previous section's record - so a 66 after a 77, or with no record, is refused. kb/Work PB2516: a constant entry closes the open record (CloseRecord), so a 66 written after a constant entry is refused COBOL2740 instead of silently renaming the record before the constant.
